statement: Independent references for static-equivalent seismic generated as the self-weight plan evaluated at the seismic case's gravity, with each entered component force W held fixed (DEL-05-01, decided by SWBPIPE's Agent 0). A force convention, not one fixed mass: it coincides with acceleration of the self-weight mass when the seismic case's gravity equals an applied self-weight's (a sufficient condition; in the limit of an applied weight tending to zero the component adds no difference at any gravity, a limit no entered document reaches, since a weight of zero is not applied); where that gravity is absent or ambiguous the equivalence is not established and the values are what the convention yields. Invented inputs; no internal pressure; generated by exact rational arithmetic without product code.

conventions.gravity: the gravity the case's loads were generated with
conventions.gravity_authored: the gravity the case states; differs from gravity only in CTRL-K-TIMES-WEIGHT-CASE
conventions.rule: the generation rule the case follows: decided, self-weight plan, or a named control
conventions.expected_model_check_warning: on seismic reference cases: a warning is expected when the case carries an applied component force and its authored gravity differs from the applied self-weight's; no warning code is assumed. On a limit case expected is null, applicable is false, with the reason
conventions.role: reference: a document a person can make; control: a wrong rule for comparison; limit: the rule evaluated where no entered document reaches (a continuity witness)
conventions.axes: members along global +X; local y = global Y, local z = global Z
conventions.disp: nodal translations ux, uy, uz (m) and right-handed rotations rx, ry, rz (rad), global
conventions.reaction: force and moment the support exerts on the structure at its node, global
conventions.end: force and moment the node exerts on the member at end i and end j, global
conventions.load: generated member loads per length (N/m) and nodal wrenches (N, N m), global
conventions.resultant: sum of the generated loads; moments about the origin
conventions.shear_model: euler_bernoulli on both routes (EX: explicit selection)
conventions.pressure: none: no pressure region, no internal pressure anywhere

crosscheck.check: two methods agree on every response row
free-node balance of element end forces
equivalent nodal loads: force equals the load resultant's force
equivalent nodal loads: moment about the origin equals the load resultant's moment

boundary 2: no component force, no warning, parity at its own gravity
boundary 3: warning, parity fails by the pipes' share
boundary 4, limit: B-C loses its load; the component force and couple are exactly zero

boundary 4: the limit has no warning expectation; the zero-weight document expects none

boundary 1: seismic XYZ at g_w_bits, equal to the weight case's gravity to the last bit
boundary 2: valve and flange both declared not consumed, so the weight case applies no component weight; weight at g_w along -Z

boundary 3: valve applied, centre of gravity offset on all three axes; seismic XYZ at g_s_ulp, one binary64 unit above the weight case's g_w_bits
